channel.title: Robotics Directory - Outdoor Robots
channel.description: Browse 258 outdoor robots in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: Segway Navimow X4
item.description: AWD, dual 180W motors, RTK + visual SLAM + LiDAR, 17 inch cutting width

item.title: Mammotion LUBA 3 AWD
item.description: The Mammotion LUBA 3 AWD 1500 is a wire-free all-wheel-drive mower for lawns up to 0.37 acre. Tri-Fusion positioning combines a 360° LiDAR, NetRTK and dual-camera AI vision, with 70 m detection range, 200,000 cloud points per second and 0.4 in claimed precision, without an RTK antenna or base station. Mammotion publishes an 80% (38.6°) slope rating, a 15 Ah battery for 215 min per charge, 41 lbs mass, IPX6, 70 dB or less noise, 1.0-2.7 in standard or 2.2-4.0 in high cutting height and 0.37, 0.75 or 1.25 acre coverage for the 1500, 3000 and 5000. It handles 300+ obstacles, 100 mowing zones, DropMow, anti-fall and lift detection, 70 cm gaps and up to 10 cloud-backed maps. The reviewed page publishes no charging time, cutting width or area rate.

item.title: Mammotion YUKA mini 2
item.description: The Mammotion YUKA mini 2 1000H is a compact wire-free mower for 0.25 acre. A 360° LiDAR with a 2,362 in (60 m) range maps the lawn automatically and generates no-go zones without a separate setup, and the mower navigates 21.7 in pathways. Mammotion publishes a 6.1 Ah battery for 2,690 sq ft per charge, a 45% (24°) slope rating, cloud backup for 10 lawn maps and a DropMow one-time mode. The reviewed page publishes no mass, dimensions, runtime in minutes, charging time, cutting width, area rate or IP rating.

item.title: Mammotion SPINO S1 Pro
item.description: CES 2026 pool robot with robot-arm self-docking AutoShoreCharge, 6,800 GPH, AI vision mapping

item.title: Segway Navimow H210
item.description: The Segway Navimow H210 is the 0.25 acre variant on the H2 series page, priced at 1,799 USD. H2 feature content describes EFLS fusion of solid-state LiDAR, Network RTK and vision, GeoSketch full-color app maps, automatic mapping, Terrain Adapt and electronic stability control for slopes to 45% (24 degrees), and VisionFence recognition of 200+ obstacle types with 0.4 in detection accuracy. The page publishes a 100 W peak mowing motor, six blades, up to 30 zones, IP66 and 60 dB(A) measured without cutting. Network RTK requires regional coverage; its access and necessary cellular data are included, while Connect+ is a separate service advertised with one year free and 32.90 USD annual renewal. Security features include geo-fence alerts, lift alarms, GPS tracking and Apple Find My. The 0.93 acre-per-day efficiency claim and faster-charging claim explicitly use H220 results and are not attributed to H210. No H210 robot dimensions, robot mass, battery capacity, runtime, charging time or cutting width are established in the extracted product content; accessory battery names and laboratory drive speeds are not substituted.

item.title: Segway Navimow i2 LiDAR (i215)
item.description: The Segway Navimow i2 LiDAR (i215) uses EFLS solid-state LiDAR and vision fusion, GeoSketch app map editing and one-click automatic lawn mapping without boundary wire or an antenna. The i215 FAQ publishes 25.0 x 17.5 x 11.3 in robot dimensions, a 0.37 acre recommended lawn size and a conditional 0.44 acre maximum map limit; these are not hourly area rates. Feature content claims approximately 200,000 LiDAR points per second, 230 ft detection range, VisionFence recognition of 200+ obstacle types with 0.4 in precision, 45% (24 degree) slopes with electronic stability control, a 100 W peak motor and six blades. It advertises up to 20 zones, ride-on edge cutting, 59 dB(A) no-load noise, IP66 and Alexa/Google Home voice control. The displayed sale price is 1,399 USD against a 1,599 USD regular price. Robot mass, battery capacity, runtime, charging time and cutting width are not established in extracted product content. Laboratory drive speed is not a product travel-speed specification, and the shared X430/X450 4G popup is not an i215 service commitment.

item.title: Beatbot Sora 30
item.description: Cordless pool robot for floors, walls, waterlines and platforms, with HydroBalance pump structure and smart parking. The March 2026 release gives Sora 30 its own 10000 mAh battery and up-to-five-hour floor-cleaning claim. Shared Sora 30/10 ratings include 5 L debris storage and 150-micron filtration; surface parking does not establish active surface skimming.

item.title: Beatbot AquaSense X
item.description: Pool-cleaning robot with vision, infrared and ultrasonic sensing, surface parking and water clarification. Users place the robot on its separate AstroRinse station for filter backwashing, waste collection and charging. The three-minute wash and 22 L station bin do not specify robot charging duration or battery endurance. Voice control is limited to outside the pool or the water surface.

item.title: Pondee X2
item.description: Cordless robotic pool vacuum with 200-minute runtime and auto-parking.

item.title: Coco Robotics Coco 2
item.description: Urban delivery robot launched February 26, 2026, with NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX onboard computing, cameras, LiDAR, GPS and neural-network/mapping navigation. The current product page retains human oversight and a Pilot Terminal for intervention. Manufacturer ratings are 21 km/h, 32 km range and 30% maximum grade, with test conditions unspecified. Swappable batteries and four 18-inch-pizza packing do not establish operating hours, kg payload or robot dimensions.

item.title: Roborock RockNeo Q110H
item.description: Dual-vision RTK plus VSLAM mower with 3 cm edge cutting and AI mapping.

item.title: Worx Landroid Vision Cloud WR308E
item.description: Wire-free robotic lawn mower for lawns up to 800 m², utilizing stereo-vision cameras, RTK Cloud, and V-SLAM to navigate without a perimeter wire.

item.title: Mondo Robotics Beni
item.description: All-terrain AI camera robot that follows and films users in 4K without a camera crew; Mondo Robotics lists Super Early Bird availability via Kickstarter.

item.title: Zeroth W1
item.description: Tracked mobile robot for outdoor work with 360Wh battery, 25h standby, 140W DC fast charging (4h full). 13MP RGB camera, 2MP monitoring camera, RGBD depth, ultrasonic and human infrared sensors. 8-core Horizon Sunrise CPU, 8GB RAM, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2, 4G, GPS/Beidou navigation. AI-powered 24/7 security surveillance, autonomous following, cargo carrying, portable power supply and smart home integration.

item.title: Hypershell X Ultra S
item.description: X Ultra S wearable outdoor exoskeleton launched May 20, 2026 with HyperIntuition motion control. Manufacturer states 1000 W maximum motor-system output and assisted wearer pace up to 25 km/h. Ultra S includes two batteries, dedicated Dune/Snow and Boost modes, and up to 30 km per-battery assistance range. Future AI Agent firmware is a roadmap statement, not a confirmed installed feature.

item.title: Hypershell X Max S
item.description: X Max S wearable outdoor exoskeleton launched May 20, 2026 with HyperIntuition motion control. Manufacturer states 1000 W maximum motor-system output and assisted wearer pace up to 25 km/h. Max S includes one battery; its exact model assistance distance is not established by the selected announcement. Future AI Agent firmware is a roadmap statement, not a confirmed installed feature.

item.title: Hypershell X Pro S
item.description: X Pro S wearable outdoor exoskeleton launched May 20, 2026 with HyperIntuition motion control. Manufacturer states 800 W maximum motor-system output and assisted wearer pace up to 20 km/h. Pro S includes one battery and up to 17.5 km standard assistance range. Future AI Agent firmware is a roadmap statement, not a confirmed installed feature.

item.title: Hypershell Halo
item.description: Full-leg wearable exoskeleton announced September 3,2026, with coordinated powered hip and knee joints, HyperIntuition 2.0 control and up to 1490 W peak four-motor output. Manufacturer states 2.6 kg system mass and up to 20 km per detachable370 g PocketVolt battery without a clear battery-inclusion mass boundary. Origin Edition preorders and phased November 2026 deliveries are dated plans, with completed deliveries unconfirmed.

item.title: Beatbot iSkim
item.description: Surface-skimming pool robot with a 9 L debris basket, 10,000 mAh battery and a 24 W solar panel. SolarTrack seeks brighter water-surface areas; adapter charging supplements solar input. App monitoring, scheduling, recall and pool-edge parking support retrieval. Continuous solar operation depends on suitable sunlight and operating conditions.

item.title: Beatbot Sora 70
item.description: Pool cleaner combining JetPulse twin-jet surface skimming with floor, wall and waterline cleaning. SonicSense ultrasonic sensing supports obstacle and depth-transition detection. Surface parking and drainage assist retrieval. February 2026 specifications give mode-dependent endurance; 6 L debris capacity and up-to-3230 sq ft pool coverage are storage and per-charge coverage, not payload or hourly throughput.

item.title: Beatbot Sora 10
item.description: Entry-level Sora pool-cleaning robot with HydroBalance structure and smart parking. The March 2026 joint release lists floor, wall, waterline and platform coverage, 6800 GPH flow, 5 L debris storage and 150-micron filtration. Sora 30’s battery capacity and five-hour floor runtime are not transferred to this model.

item.title: Dephy Sidekick
item.description: Consumer ankle exoskeleton paired with dedicated sneakers that acts as an 'extra calf muscle'. It learns the wearer's gait and adds push-off assistance at adjustable power levels. Sold as a wellness product, not a medical device.

item.title: Mammotion LUBA 4 AWD
item.description: Flagship all-wheel-drive robot mower series (3000F, 6000F and 12000F) for lawns of 3,000 to 12,000 m2. It navigates without a boundary wire using Tri-Fusion positioning: 360-degree LiDAR, NetRTK and four cameras that recognise more than 300 object types. It climbs slopes of up to 80% (38.6 degrees) and takes an optional edge-trimming accessory. Announced at IFA 2026, with pre-orders in Q4 2026.

item.title: Mammotion LUBA mini 2 AWD
item.description: Compact all-wheel-drive robot mower. The 1000 model (1,000 m2) uses tri-camera AI vision with NetRTK, and the 1500 model uses 360-degree LiDAR with dual cameras. It needs no boundary wire, has an edge-cutting disc and detects obstacles as small as 2.5 x 2.5 cm. Rated IPX6.

item.title: Segway Navimow i2 AWD
item.description: All-wheel-drive version of Segway Navimow's wire-free i2 mower for everyday lawns. The i206 AWD covers 0.15 acre and the i210 AWD 0.25 acre. It uses Xero-turn AWD steering that is gentle on turf and climbs 45% (24 degree) slopes. Unveiled at CES 2026, with pre-orders from January 16, 2026.

item.title: Segway Navimow Terranox
item.description: Segway Navimow's commercial all-wheel-drive robotic mower series for large sites, with 'drop and mow' setup. The CM120M1 covers up to 3 acres and the CM240M1 up to 6 acres. Unveiled at CES 2026.

item.title: Sunseeker S4
item.description: Sunseeker's first LiDAR robot mower, for lawns up to 1,000 m2. Its 172-channel LiDAR is combined with AI vision, so it needs no perimeter wire or antenna. It handles slopes of 42% (22 degrees), avoids obstacles in 3D and is rated IPX6. CES Innovation Awards 2026 honoree; launched March 3, 2026.

item.title: Sunseeker S7 LiDAR Ultra AWD 3000
item.description: Flagship 2027-model-year all-wheel-drive robot mower for up to 3,000 m2. It maps with 360-degree LiDAR and AI vision and needs no base station. It climbs 80% slopes, cuts with a 35 cm dual-disc deck and supports an optional EdgeZero trimmer head. Shown at IFA 2026.

item.title: Sunseeker S5 LiDAR Ultra AWD 1800
item.description: 2027-model-year all-wheel-drive LiDAR robot mower for mid-sized to large gardens up to 1,800 m2. It climbs 80% slopes, uses the AllSense 2.0 perception system and has a dedicated cut-to-edge disc. Shown at IFA 2026.

item.title: ECOVACS ULTRAMARINE P1
item.description: ECOVACS' first cordless robotic pool cleaner, covering up to 180 m2. It has 4,800 GPH suction, four roller brushes and two filter layers (180 and 3 microns). It navigates with SmartNavi IMU, has an IP68 body and a 4600 mAh battery, and climbs obstacles of 5.5 cm.

item.title: Dreame A3 AWD Pro
item.description: Four-wheel-drive wire-free robot mower for yards up to 5,000 m2. OmniSense 3.0 combines 360-degree 3D LiDAR with dual 1080p HDR cameras and recognises more than 300 obstacle types. It climbs 80% (38.7 degree) slopes and cuts a 40 cm swath. EdgeMaster 2.0 edge trimming leaves gaps under 3 cm, and Garden Guardian adds video security.

item.title: Husqvarna Automower 405VE NERA
item.description: Wire-free NERA mower with AI Vision camera object detection, satellite navigation and EdgeCut, for lawns up to 900 m². It was announced in October 2025 as part of Husqvarna's 2026 AI Vision range.

item.title: Husqvarna Automower 410VE NERA
item.description: AI Vision NERA mower for lawns up to 1,500 m², with camera object avoidance, EdgeCut, selectable mowing patterns and electric height adjustment.

item.title: Husqvarna Automower 430V NERA
item.description: Large-garden AI Vision NERA mower with virtual boundaries for up to 4,800 m². It handles 50% slopes and has a 24 cm cutting width.

item.title: Husqvarna Automower 450V NERA
item.description: Flagship AI Vision NERA mower that covers up to 7,500 m² with systematic patterns. It handles slopes of up to 50% inside the work area.

item.title: Husqvarna Automower Aspire R6V
item.description: Entry-level wire-free mower with AI vision and satellite navigation for gardens up to 600 m². It is rated IPX6 and runs at 63 dB(A).

item.title: Husqvarna Automower 308V
item.description: Wire-free AI vision mower for gardens up to 800 m², with selectable mowing patterns and smart-home integration. It launched on 2 March 2026.

item.title: Husqvarna Automower 312V
item.description: Wire-free AI vision mower for gardens up to 1,200 m², with camera object avoidance and satellite navigation. It needs Wi-Fi coverage across the whole lawn.

item.title: Gardena smart SILENO sense
item.description: Wire-free robotic mower with camera-based AI navigation, edge detection and obstacle avoidance. It comes in 400 m² and 600 m² versions, handles 25% slopes and cuts at 25 to 45 mm.

item.title: Daxbot Dax Helium-Class Security Robot
item.description: Autonomous patrol robot with human-verified alerts and remote command-center escalation.

item.title: ECOVACS GOAT O1000 RTK
item.description: The ECOVACS GOAT O1000 RTK is a robotic lawn mower measuring 23.62 x 15.75 x 10.35 in and weighing 24.25 lb. It cuts an 8.66 in path at 1.2-3.2 in height, climbs 45% (24 degree) slopes, passes 2.3 ft narrow paths, carries a 4,000 mAh 18 V battery, charges in about 100 min and mows for about 65 min per charge. Noise is 57 dBA, the mower, station and RTK antenna are IPX6 rated, and manufacturer laboratory mowing efficiency is about 1,507-1,938 ft2/h. Travel speed is 1.15 ft/s delicate or 1.64 ft/s efficient. Current price is 999.99 USD. No payload, degrees of freedom, age range or water tank capacity is published; the catalog 1,000 USD price, ~10 kg mass, small size label and ~2 hour battery label are replaced or cleared.

item.title: Segway Navimow X3 Series
item.description: RTK+AI vision wire-free mower, 0.5-2.5 acre models, 27° slopes, 60 dB, IP66, up to 240 min runtime

item.title: Mammotion LUBA mini AWD
item.description: The Mammotion LUBA mini AWD 1500H is a compact wire-free all-wheel-drive mower for 0.37 acre. Mammotion publishes an 80% (38.6°) slope rating, 8 cm (3.2 in) vertical obstacle clearance, 2.2-4.0 in cutting height, up to 20 mowing zones, a 6.1 Ah battery for 160 min per charge and 88 W cutting motors. Free NetRTK provides centimetre-level positioning without an RTK installation. The 800H version covers 0.2 acre and costs 1,599 USD. The reviewed page publishes no mass, dimensions, charging time, cutting width, area rate or IP rating.

item.title: Mammotion YUKA 2000
item.description: The Mammotion YUKA 2000 is a rear-wheel-drive mower for lawns up to 2,000 m², listed at 1,699 EUR in the EU store and currently sold out. Free NetRTK gives centimetre-level positioning without a wire or RTK installation, and UltraSense AI Vision runs on a 5 TOPS chip. Mammotion publishes 45% (24°) slopes, 30 mowing zones, a dual floating cutting disc with 88 W motors and 300+ obstacle avoidance. An optional sweeper kit clears leaves and twigs up to 3.5 cm and empties at up to 150 app-set dumping spots. The reviewed page publishes no mass, dimensions, battery capacity, runtime, charging time, cutting width, area rate or IP rating.

item.title: Dreame Roboticmower A1 Pro
item.description: The Dreame Roboticmower A1 Pro is a wire-free robotic lawn mower with an OmniSense 3D ultra-sensing system, 3D LiDAR and 3D omnidirectional obstacle avoidance. The manufacturer publishes 643 x 437 x 261 mm robot dimensions, a 778 x 490 x 309 mm charging station, 12 kg robot weight, 3.3 kg station weight, a 2,000 m2 working-area capacity, 1,000 m2 per 24 h standard and 2,000 m2 per 24 h efficient mowing, 3-7 cm cutting height, 22 cm cutting width, 45% (24 degree) maximum slope, a 5 Ah battery, 3 A charging current, 65-minute charging and IPX6. LiDAR is stated at up to 70 m detection distance with a 360 x 59 degree field of view and 1 cm mapping precision in Dreame laboratory testing. No runtime, travel speed or hourly area rate is published. The 1,000/2,000 m2 figures are 24-hour laboratory claims rather than hourly rates, and station dimensions are not robot dimensions.

item.title: ECOVACS GOAT A1600 RTK
item.description: The GOAT A1600 RTK is a robotic lawn mower built on a 32 V platform with dual blade discs. The manufacturer publishes a 0.7 m/s travel speed, 3,000 rpm blade rotation, 400 m2/h mowing output with 500 m2 per 2 h in laboratory testing, 45-minute charging at 180 W, a 3-9 cm cutting height in 1 cm steps, 2 cm RTK positioning precision, 50% (27 degree) slope climbing, 4 cm barrier crossing, IPX6 and a 15-minute wire-free setup. AIVI 3D with a Horizon X5 chipset is claimed to avoid more than 200 obstacle types. No price, robot mass, dimensions, battery capacity, runtime or cutting width is published in the reviewed content. The 32 V figure is platform voltage rather than battery capacity, and blade rotation is not travel speed.

item.title: Husqvarna Automower 440 iQ
item.description: The Husqvarna Automower 440 iQ is a wire-free robotic lawn mower for lawns up to 2 acres (plus or minus 20%) with EPOS satellite positioning, virtual boundaries and a reference station. It handles slopes up to 15% at the boundary and 45% inside the installation, runs up to 24 hours of active time and cuts at 9.4 in width with three pivoting razor blades and an electric cutting-height range of 1 to 4 in. A 7.5 Ah lithium-ion battery supports about 138 minutes of mowing per charge and recharges in 54 minutes at 7 A. The robot weighs 39 lbs, measures 29.6 x 21.4 x 11.1 in, is rated IPX5, emits 62 dB(A) and connects over cellular, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth with the Automower Connect app, radar object detection, GPS tracking, GeoFence, PIN code, alarm, lift and tilt sensors. The purchase includes a 4-year warranty and one year of free blades. The page publishes no payload, travel speed, hourly area rate or water tank capacity.

item.title: Eufy Robot Lawn Mower E15
item.description: The Eufy Robot Lawn Mower E15 is a wire-free robotic mower for lawns up to 0.2 acres (8,700 sq ft) with an 8 in (203 mm) cutting width and a 1 to 3 in (25 to 75 mm) cutting height. It handles slopes up to 18 degrees and cuts grass under 3.5 in with a height difference under 1.2 in, and it is not recommended for St. Augustine or dense Zoysia grass. It measures 60.3 x 39.4 x 31.8 cm and weighs 12.5 kg, with a 93.24 Wh battery, 90 to 110 minutes of mowing per charge and 90 to 110 minutes of charging time. The robot is rated IPX6, emits under 56 dB, connects over Wi-Fi with app and OTA updates, and includes GPS, 4G and an anti-theft system plus automatic rain and low-light recall. The base station measures 72.7 x 48 x 45.2 cm, weighs 6.5 kg and is also rated IPX6. The page publishes no payload, travel speed, hourly area rate or water tank capacity.

item.title: Eufy Robot Lawn Mower E18
item.description: Pure-vision FSD mower for 1,200 m², camera-only nav without wires or RTK, 40% slopes

item.title: Airseekers Tron
item.description: 5-camera AI vision + RTK mower for 2,400 m², 65% slopes, FlowCut mulching, 3 h runtime, 65 dB
